app.name: Lone Lookout
app.short_description: A quiet season in a fire lookout
app.long_description:
Spend the last eleven days of a fire season as the lookout on Kestrel Knob in the Ashen Peaks. Walk the six places around the tower, read the old lookout's notes, listen for the sounds he logged, keep the weather readings, and talk on the radio with Dot at Basin Station. No combat, no timers, no fail states. The story takes four to six hours.
Controls (Wii Remote + Nunchuk): stick to walk, point to look, A to use or sit, B for the radio, hold C to listen, hold Z to stride, D-pad up for the binoculars, D-pad down for the notebook, HOME or + to pause. Without a Nunchuk: D-pad to walk and turn, 1 binoculars, 2 notebook, hold - to listen; seated, hold the D-pad down to let time pass.
Saves go to sd:/apps/lonelookout/save.dat. Recorded voice lines, if you have them, go in sd:/apps/lonelookout/vo/.
